beats.text: Polly walks backward to the left, pulling Pax in from the right by his flipper
Pax lets go and twirls with his flippers spread, landing in a pose with a wink while Polly reaches toward him from the left edge
Pax stands smiling with rosy cheeks while Polly, half out of view at the left edge, holds a flipper out toward him
Polly closes her eyes and rests a flipper against her cheek while Pax turns his head to look at her

spans.notes: plain ground (RGB about 210,225,235) with no background marks, so a pan could not be seen; per the plain-ground ruling compare decides, and the shadows keep one size (foreground bottom row 1334-1337 f0-75, Pax 506 px tall f27-45), so no zoom. f0-11 both leads slide left as Polly walks backward drawing Pax in, as drawn. Polly is fully in view f0-8, then cut off at the left edge for the rest of the span (presence partial). A push-in starts at f76 (shadow row 1340, 1353, 1419...). No overlay (top and bottom bands clean every frame)
fast push-in on Pax: shadow bottom row 1340 (f76), 1353, 1419, 1510, 1539, settled 1546 from f81; Pax 516 -> 796 px tall. 5 frames, so too_short ranks before camera_move

beats.text: Pax stands with his flippers folded across his chest and a sulky frown, eyes narrowed to the side
Polly leans in from the left beside Pax, smiling with her eyes closed

beats.text: Polly snuggles against Pax's side, both smiling with their eyes closed
Polly glances sideways at Pax with a sheepish look while he stares straight ahead with wide eyes
Polly turns to Pax and kisses his cheek, wrapping a flipper around him, while he squints one eye shut
Polly squeezes Pax in a tight hug with her eyes closed while he looks ahead with a worried, embarrassed face

beats.text: Polly hugs Pax's arm and nuzzles against him while he stands with rosy cheeks and a nervous look
Polly lets go and walks off to the right, pointing back at Pax, while he holds his flippers out in surprise
Pax stands alone with his flippers out, then folds them across his chest
Pax stands with his flippers crossed and his eyes shut in a huffy pout

beats.text: Pax stands alone with his flippers folded and his eyes squeezed shut, pouting
Polly peeks back in from the right with her flippers clasped under her chin while Pax keeps pouting
Polly hops over to stand right beside Pax
Polly leans against Pax with her flippers clasped, looking up at him, while he glances down at her with a worried face
Pax turns to Polly and kisses her cheek while she closes her eyes
Pax wraps a flipper around Polly as she blushes and smiles up at him
Pax and Polly stand facing each other, holding each other's flippers
Pax and Polly pull each other into a tight hug, both smiling with closed eyes
